items.claim: Porsche Design System exposes framework-agnostic design tokens so shared design decisions can be consumed across implementations.
Porsche spacing guidance distinguishes fluid spacing, used mainly for vertical rhythm, from static spacing, used mainly for horizontal and component relationships.
Porsche color guidance uses a limited semantic palette with light and dark mode relationships and warns against inventing extra colors or mixing theme roles.
items.notes: Supports color restraint and role integrity.

items.claim: Porsche typography guidance emphasizes the system's defined type styles and regular-weight hierarchy rather than decorative italics or arbitrary type styling.
The transferable premium quality comes from precision, rhythm, material restraint, and strong product focus rather than stereotypical luxury colors or decoration.
